caseName: Moister v. General Motors Acceptance Corp.
caseNameFull: Moister, as Chapter 7 Trustee for Busenlehner v. General Motors Acceptance Corp. and Moister, as Chapter 7 Trustee for Howard v. First National Bank of Atlanta

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir. Motion of petitioner to defer consideration of petition for writ of certiorari denied. Certiorari denied. Justice White would grant certiorari.
